record.paper_title: Positive and free boundary solutions to singular nonlinear elliptic problems with absorption: an overview and open problems
record.original_question: Consider problem (III), -Δu = K(x)(λu^β - u^α) in Ω with u = 0 on ∂Ω, where K(x)=1/d(x)^k, 0 < k < 2, and 0 < α < β < 1, together with its p-Laplacian generalization discussed later in the paper. In the regime k-α < 1, is there more than one positive solution?

evidence.quote: -Δu = K(x)(λu^β-u^α) in Ω, u = 0 on ∂Ω, with K(x)=1/d(x)^k with 0<k<2 and 0<α<β<1.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\Omega \subset \mathbb{R}^N$ ($N \geq 1$) be a bounded domain with smooth boundary $\partial \Omega$, and let $d(x) := \mathrm{dist}(x,\partial\Omega)$. Fix exponents $0 < \alpha < \beta < 1$ and a parameter $0 < k < 2$, and define the singular weight $K(x) = 1/d(x)^k$. For $\lambda > 0$ consider the singular semilinear Dirichlet problem
$$
-\Delta u = K(x)\bigl(\lambda u^{\beta} - u^{\alpha}\bigr) \quad \text{in } \Omega, \qquad u = 0 \text{ on } \partial\Omega, \qquad u > 0 \text{ in } \Omega,
$$
together with its $p$-Laplacian counterpart
$$
-\Delta_p u = K(x)\bigl(\lambda u^{\beta} - u^{\alpha}\bigr) \quad \text{in } \Omega, \qquad u = 0 \text{ on } \partial\Omega, \qquad u > 0 \text{ in } \Omega,
$$
where $1 < p < \infty$ and $\Delta_p u = \mathrm{div}(|\nabla u|^{p-2}\nabla u)$. Restrict to the parameter regime
$$
k - \alpha < 1.
$$
In this regime, determine whether the problem can admit more than one positive solution: does there exist a value of $\lambda > 0$ (and possibly of $p$) for which the above problem has at least two distinct positive solutions, or is the positive solution unique whenever it exists?
artifact.status_search_result: A targeted web search did not surface a definitive resolution of this specific multiplicity question for the singular absorption problem $-\Delta u = d(x)^{-k}(\lambda u^\beta - u^\alpha)$ with $0<\alpha<\beta<1$ and $k-\alpha<1$, nor for its $p$-Laplacian generalization. While there is an active literature on multiplicity for related singular elliptic equations (Nehari manifold, sub/supersolutions, critical point methods), no source clearly settles the multiplicity question in this regime, so the status is unknown.

status_evidence.title: Multiplicity of singular solutions for semilinear elliptic equations
status_evidence.snippet: Multiplicity results for semilinear elliptic equations with superlinear source terms; does not address the sublinear singular absorption problem with k-α<1.
status_evidence.claim: No direct treatment of the specific problem found.

status_evidence.title: Singular elliptic and parabolic equations (Handbook chapter)
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of singular elliptic problems; does not state a multiplicity result for the convex-concave singular weighted problem in the regime k-α<1.
status_evidence.claim: Status of the precise multiplicity question remains unresolved in available sources.
